verdicts.note: Named Clare and repeatedly referred to as a woman; clearly female.
BSc Construction Management maps to Civil & Building Engineering.
'Also a well paid job' names pay as a draw to the field; agree fits.
'neither parent is in engineering industry' supports strongly disagree.
'No previous experience of the industry' supports chose with little knowledge; agree.
'Didn't have any careers advice at school' supports strongly disagree on careers-advisor encouragement.
'Happy with all career choices' is about satisfaction, not whether anyone discouraged her; quote does not address the discouragement question (and a QS-lecturer episode arguably cuts the other way).
'really enjoys' plus 'enjoyed the course so far' supports strongly agree.
Improved confidence working with the guys is interpersonal-skill development; agree fits.
Quote is a general claim that good engineers need confidence (perceived male); says nothing about male vs female students' confidence in class.
'No personal tutor' means the item is not applicable; absence of a tutor does not express neutral satisfaction.
'a fellow student ... very encouraging' supports satisfaction with friends; thin, low confidence retained.
'Is going on placement with [company]' confirms yes.
Principal reason was lack of industry experience; strongly agree fits.
'best thing will be getting paid' signals pay matters but item is about NEEDING money; agree at low confidence is defensible.
'would count more than anything else' for getting jobs supports strongly agree.
Having no industry experience supports wanting an idea of what industry is like; agree, low conf.
'will improve confidence' supports personal development; agree.
'help with assignments in the final year' supports improving grades; agree.
Does not expect to put theory into practice; disagree fits (could be stronger).
Placement was a voluntary choice (not all students go), so 'other' rather than compulsory; low conf.
'a good project manager' supports project management specialism.
Executive of own company / project manager supports managerial role.
'earning lots of money' as a key aspiration supports very important.
Stated preference to work abroad (climate) shows location matters; important, low conf.
Wanting to work in Australia shows mobility/openness to working abroad; thin (motivation stated is prospects), low conf.
'nice car' is a generic life-goal in a husband/house/car list rather than a job company-car benefit; weakest available signal, low conf.
Citing good career prospects/shortage of professionals supports promotion opportunities mattering; important, low conf.
